# Needs and Wants

<!-- STEP id="needs" -->
**Needs** are what we must have to live: food, clean water, shelter and clothing.

<!-- STEP id="wants" -->
**Wants** make life more comfortable or more fun: a new phone, a video game, a trip to a water park. We can live without them.

<!-- STEP id="context" -->
The same thing can be either. A bicycle Meera rides to school every day does the job of a need. The same bicycle, used only for weekend fun, is a want.

Ask what job it does, not what it is.
